Have you ever found yourself wrestling with big questions—ones that tug at your heart and challenge what you believe? You’re definitely not alone. Doubt and faith, it turns out, are often companions on the same journey, especially when life throws its toughest challenges our way. Together, we’re about to set out on an exploration inspired by Lee Strobel’s The Case for Faith. What makes this journey so compelling is how it doesn’t shy away from those difficult questions—like why suffering exists, why faith can feel exclusive, and how to make sense of contradictions that sometimes seem to hide within Christianity. Instead of glossing over those struggles, Strobel digs in with honesty and a curious spirit, mixing heartfelt personal stories, expert voices, and thoughtful investigation. We’ll explore the very real emotional and philosophical weight that comes with doubt, and why it’s okay—even necessary—to ask questions.
As we walk through this landscape of belief and skepticism, we’re invited to look a little deeper—not just to defend faith, but to really understand it. So, if you’ve ever wondered whether faith and doubt can truly coexist, or if answers can be found amidst the struggle, you’re in the right place. Let’s discover together how the search for meaning, truth, and compassion can become a transformative adventure—one that just might change the way we see everything.
